name: actionable-philosophy-book-club
description: Static SPA for philosophy book club meetings

scripts.build:vendor: terser node_modules/marked/lib/marked.umd.js --compress --mangle -o dist/vendor/marked.min.js && cp node_modules/dompurify/dist/purify.min.js dist/vendor/
scripts.build:js: node scripts/inline-manifest.cjs && terser src/_manifest.js src/00-setup.js src/data-meeting.js src/01-utils.js src/02-manifest.js src/03-assets.js src/04-dashboard.js src/05-reader.js src/06-view.js src/07-toast.js src/08-video-player.js src/09-asset-delegation.js src/10-onboarding.js src/11-theme.js src/12-routing.js src/13-app.js src/14-test-hooks.js --compress --mangle --comments false -o dist/app.js && terser src/theme-init.js --compress --mangle -o dist/theme-init.js
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:vendor && npm run build:js
